name: log_beech
form_origin: A HORIZONTAL WOODY BODY. The leader's axis leaves the base almost level, so height_m is the LOG'S LENGTH and not a standing height — TreeGrower::NormalizeToUnitHeight measures a lying form along its longest horizontal extent, because normalising by the vertical one would scale the log's DIAMETER to the declared metres. Both ends are broken; the root plate requirements III.16 asks for beside a windthrow is not built.
dimensions_origin: [SET] from the mature open-grown band a European field guide gives the species; no measurement of an individual is claimed and every one is falsifiable against a photograph with a scale in it.
dbh_cm_origin: the diameter of the dead stem at 1.3 m where the form reaches it; 0 where it does not, and base_radius stands as declared.
lai_origin: 0: foliate is 0, the form carries no leaf at all and no card is grown.
bark_origin: sRGB. Beech bark on the ground: greyed, and darker than the standing tree because it holds water.
